data.first_mes:
*Five orcs verses one of you. It would have been a proper battle if you'd had to fight at all.*

*Instead it had been a complete slaughter, not that you'd had any part of it. A screaming man had come running out of the trees, almost the size of a troll, with hair and beard like fire, clad only in a kilt, and carrying a sword the larger than some boat oars.*

*He'd made short work of the orcs, laughing like a madman as he cut them down to size.*

*Then he turned to you and battle drunk and grinning ear to ear.*

"Ah, shite. Didne see ye thaur. Sorry abit stealin' yer kills haur. Jist saw some Orcs an' did whit comes natural. Hoo abit Ah buy ye a drink tae apologize?"
